parsed.text: This packet contains fallible location distributions for red and blue at four nodes on 4×4 local grids in two panels (p0, p1). Current (non-candidate) estimates: panel p0 — n0: blue distribution peaks at (0,1), red at (0,3); n1 and n2: both roles uniform across all 16 cells; n3: blue peaks at (1,2), red peaks at (0,1). Panel p1 current — n0: blue (0,1), red (0,3); n1, n2, n3: uniform across all cells. Candidates (conditional command records k0,k1,k2) are not executed events. Where commands provide alternatives, peak cells are often stable but peak probabilities differ: in p0 n3 all candidate commands keep blue peak at (1,2) and red peak at (0,1) while their peak probabilities change across k0/k1/k2. In panel p1 n3 the candidate records differ in mode: k0 is uniform, k1 places blue mass on four cells and red mass on four different cells, and k2 concentrates blue at (1,2) and red at (0,1). Copied prior records are noted as inherited, not new observations.
